I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random: the ticket is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026 as the Eastbank receiving-door import for Marrow Agrisupply. In my reply I also passed on his note that the import file labels the doors E1/E2, while Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02.

I'd already checked the channel list on the last request: Tobias is a member of #central-team, so this came from a channel he can see himself. A ticket number is account information, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share it with the account's team.
